occurrences.text: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
